issues.title: Input clipped at bottom viewport boundary
issues.description: The caption refinement input box extends past the viewport, truncating its bottom border.
issues.evidence: The lower border of the 'refine caption' input group is cut off at the bottom right.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or constrain the sidebar height with internal scrolling.
issues.triageNote: Playwright measurement (1280x800): the eval page's 380px inspector aside is 744px tall with overflow-y:auto but holds 803px of content (59px over-full) and pins the caption section to the fold via mt-auto — section bottom y=846.5 vs viewport 800 (46.5px overhang, matching the auditor's ~47px). The component itself is healthy: InputGroup root is flex-shrink:1/w-full/flex-wrap with zero horizontal overflow (scrollW==clientW), min-w-0 present on both InputGroupInput and InputGroupTextarea, and the textarea renders at its designed min-h-16 (64px; content-driven height would be 56px — only 8px of the 46.5px overhang). Root cause lives in src/app/eval/pair-003/page.tsx (off-limits); no component fix would resolve it.
